source.author: project
source.documentTitle: 2017 Trust Services Criteria for Security, Availability, Processing Integrity, Confidentiality, and Privacy (with revised points of focus, 2022) (criterion IDs only; titles and descriptions written by the project)

requirements.title: Integrity and ethical values
requirements.description: Leadership sets the tone that honest and ethical behaviour is expected, and the organization holds people to it.

requirements.title: Board oversight
requirements.description: The board works independently of management and oversees how internal control is designed and run.

requirements.title: Structure, authority and reporting lines
requirements.description: Management sets up the organization's structure, reporting lines and the authority and duties each role has.

requirements.title: Competent people
requirements.description: The organization hires, develops and keeps people with the skills needed to meet its objectives.

requirements.title: Accountability for internal control
requirements.description: People are held accountable for their part in internal control as they pursue the organization's objectives.

requirements.title: Quality information for control
requirements.description: The organization gets or produces relevant, good-quality information that supports internal control.

requirements.title: Internal communication
requirements.description: Objectives and responsibilities for internal control are communicated inside the organization.

requirements.title: External communication
requirements.description: The organization communicates with outside parties about matters that affect how internal control works.

requirements.title: Clear objectives
requirements.description: Objectives are stated clearly enough that the risks to reaching them can be identified and assessed.

requirements.title: Risk identification and analysis
requirements.description: Risks to the objectives are identified across the organization and analysed to decide how to manage them.

requirements.title: Fraud risk
requirements.description: The chance of fraud is considered when the organization assesses risks to its objectives.

requirements.title: Changes that affect control
requirements.description: Significant changes that could affect internal control are identified and assessed.

requirements.title: Ongoing and separate evaluations
requirements.description: The organization checks, continuously or periodically, that the parts of internal control are present and working.

requirements.title: Reporting control deficiencies
requirements.description: Control weaknesses are reported in time to those who must fix them, including senior management and the board.

requirements.title: Control activities that reduce risk
requirements.description: The organization picks and builds control activities that bring risks to its objectives down to acceptable levels.

requirements.title: General controls over technology
requirements.description: The organization picks and builds general controls over its technology to support its objectives.

requirements.title: Policies and procedures
requirements.description: Control activities are put in place through policies stating what is expected and procedures that carry them out.

requirements.title: Logical access security
requirements.description: Software, infrastructure and architecture protect information assets from unauthorized logical access.

requirements.title: User registration and authorization
requirements.description: New users are registered and authorized before credentials are issued, and access is removed when no longer needed.

requirements.title: Role-based access changes
requirements.description: Access to data, software and systems is granted, changed and removed by role, following least privilege.

requirements.title: Physical access restrictions
requirements.description: Physical access to facilities and protected information assets is limited to authorized people.

requirements.title: Secure disposal of assets
requirements.description: Data and software are removed from physical assets before they are disposed of, so information cannot be recovered.

requirements.title: Protection at the system boundary
requirements.description: Measures protect the system against threats coming from outside its boundaries.

requirements.title: Protecting data in movement
requirements.description: Transmission, movement and removal of information are limited to authorized users and processes and protected.

requirements.title: Preventing malicious software
requirements.description: Measures prevent or detect unauthorized or malicious software being introduced into the system.

requirements.title: Detecting vulnerabilities and configuration changes
requirements.description: Detection and monitoring find configuration changes and newly found vulnerabilities that could cause harm.

requirements.title: Monitoring for anomalies
requirements.description: System components are monitored for unusual activity that may signal attacks, errors or natural disasters.

requirements.title: Evaluating security events
requirements.description: Security events are evaluated to decide whether they are incidents that could stop objectives being met.

requirements.title: Incident response
requirements.description: A defined response programme is used to understand, contain, fix and communicate about security incidents.

requirements.title: Incident recovery
requirements.description: Activities are identified and carried out to recover from security incidents that have happened.

requirements.title: Change management
requirements.description: Changes to infrastructure, data, software and procedures are authorized, designed, tested, approved and recorded.

requirements.title: Business disruption risk
requirements.description: Risks from possible business disruptions are identified, and mitigation activities are chosen and built.

requirements.title: Vendor and business partner risk
requirements.description: Risks linked to vendors and business partners are assessed and managed.

requirements.title: Capacity planning
requirements.description: Current processing capacity and use are maintained and monitored so capacity can grow to meet demand.

requirements.title: Environmental protection, backup and recovery infrastructure
requirements.description: Environmental protections, software, data backups and recovery infrastructure are put in place and kept working.

requirements.title: Recovery plan testing
requirements.description: The procedures for recovering the system are tested to show they support its availability commitments.

requirements.title: Identifying confidential information
requirements.description: Confidential information is identified and kept in a way that protects its confidentiality.

requirements.title: Disposing of confidential information
requirements.description: Confidential information is disposed of in a way that meets the organization's confidentiality commitments.

requirements.title: Processing specifications
requirements.description: Information about processing, including definitions of the data and what is processed, is obtained or produced and used.

requirements.title: System input controls
requirements.description: Inputs to the system are checked for completeness and accuracy so processing results are reliable.

requirements.title: Processing controls
requirements.description: System processing is controlled so products, services and reports meet their specifications.

requirements.title: Output controls
requirements.description: Outputs are produced completely and accurately and delivered only to the intended recipients on time.

requirements.title: Storage of inputs and outputs
requirements.description: Stored inputs, items in processing and outputs are kept complete, accurate and timely, in line with specifications.

requirements.title: Privacy notice
requirements.description: Data subjects are told how their personal information is collected, used, kept, shared and disposed of.

requirements.title: Choice and consent
requirements.description: Data subjects are told their choices about their personal information, and consent is obtained and recorded where needed.

requirements.title: Collection in line with objectives
requirements.description: Personal information is collected only as needed for the organization's privacy objectives.

requirements.title: Explicit consent for collection
requirements.description: Explicit consent is obtained, and recorded, before collecting personal information that requires it.

requirements.title: Limited use
requirements.description: Personal information is used only for the purposes the organization's privacy objectives allow.

requirements.title: Retention
requirements.description: Personal information is kept only as long as needed to meet the organization's privacy objectives.

requirements.title: Secure disposal
requirements.description: Personal information is disposed of securely once it is no longer needed.

requirements.title: Access by data subjects
requirements.description: Data subjects who are identified and authenticated can see and get a copy of their stored personal information.

requirements.title: Correction requests
requirements.description: Data subjects can ask to correct personal information, and the change is made or the refusal explained.

requirements.title: Disclosure to third parties
requirements.description: Personal information is shared with third parties only for permitted purposes and with consent where needed.

requirements.title: Record of authorized disclosures
requirements.description: A full, accurate record is kept of authorized disclosures of personal information.

requirements.title: Record of unauthorized disclosures
requirements.description: A full, accurate record is kept of detected or reported unauthorized disclosures, including breaches.

requirements.title: Third-party privacy commitments
requirements.description: Vendors and other third parties given personal information are bound to privacy commitments and checked.

requirements.title: Notification from third parties
requirements.description: Third parties that hold personal information must report actual or suspected unauthorized disclosures.

requirements.title: Breach notification
requirements.description: Affected data subjects, regulators and others are notified of breaches and incidents as commitments require.

requirements.title: Accounting of personal information held
requirements.description: Data subjects can learn what personal information is held about them and to whom it has been disclosed.

requirements.title: Data quality
requirements.description: Personal information is kept accurate, complete and relevant for the purposes it is used for.

requirements.title: Privacy inquiries, complaints and disputes
requirements.description: Privacy inquiries, complaints and disputes are received, handled and resolved, and compliance is monitored.
